outputs: Actual clinically selected proposed plan and exact requested services, not an inferred test choice

Actual captured field mapping from s1

outputs: Actual laboratory request acknowledgment or stopped failure

inputs: Actual plan, request status and coordination from s2/s5/s6
outputs: Complete checked actual coordination note

steps.what: Save the factual coordination note in the same patient record
outputs: Stored actual plan-coordination note
